---
title: "Explore the distance threshold for proximity networks"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

Build cell proximity networks across a range of polygon distance thresholds, compare their edge counts, and relate a selected threshold to cell polygon diameters.

Source script: [R/SettingDist_proximityNetwork.R](../R/SettingDist_proximityNetwork.R). The code below retains the source script's order and comments.

## Setup

Enable evaluation and code display for all chunks, and resolve the source script's relative paths from the project root when knitting this file from the Vignettes folder.

```{r setup, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = normalizePath("..", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
)
```

## Load packages

Load the spatial graph, plotting, and animation libraries.

```{r step-01, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
library("RGraphSpace")
library("sf")
library("ggplot2")
library("igraph")
library("dplyr")

#install.packages("gifski")
library(gifski)

```

## Load the Xenium crop

Download the cropped GraphSpace object if needed and read it into the session.

```{r step-02, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# download crop
diretorio_dados <- "data"
url_dados <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flaviogckessler/Curso_ST/",
  "main/data/Xenium_GS_Crop.RDS")

arquivo_dados <- file.path(diretorio_dados, "Xenium_GS_Crop.RDS")

if (!file.exists(arquivo_dados)) {
  utils::download.file(url_dados,arquivo_dados,mode = "wb")}

gs_crop <- readRDS(arquivo_dados)

if (!inherits(gs_crop, "GraphSpace")) {
  stop("O arquivo baixado não contém um objeto da classe GraphSpace.")}

gs_crop
#########
```

## Configure plotting

Define the shared palette, expression range, and coordinate theme.

```{r step-03, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Set color palette and data range for use across plots
cpal <- hcl.colors(100, palette = "Spectral", rev = T)
data_range <- c(0, 7)
# Set a reusable theme
my_theme <- theme_gspace_coords(theme = "th3", is_norm = TRUE, 
                                xlab = "Tissue coordinates 1", ylab = "Tissue coordinates 2")
#########
```

## Load the neighbor helper

Source the helper used to build cell proximity graphs.

```{r step-04, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# load function that calculate that find the spot/cells neighbors based on the cell segmentation info
source("R/gs_neighbors_func.R")
#########
```

## Define the distance sweep

Set the distance thresholds, initialize the edge-count table, and prepare a starting plot.

```{r step-05, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
dist_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = 0.002, by = 0.0001)
edges_by_dist <- data.frame(
  dist = dist_vec,
  edges = NA,
  row.names = dist_vec
)

g <- ggplot(gs_crop) +
  geom_edgespace(color="red")+
  geom_nodespace(color="black",
                 size = .2,pch = 19) +
  scale_colour_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range)+
  theme_gspace_coords(theme = "th3",is_norm = TRUE)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title = "Cell proximity, No edges",x=NULL,y=NULL)
png_files <- c(g)

```

## Build networks across thresholds

Construct a network for each distance, collect the plots, and record edge counts and elapsed time.

```{r step-06, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
inicio <- Sys.time()
for (i in 1:length(dist_vec)) {
  gs_prox <- gs_neighbors(gs_crop,dist=dist_vec[i])
  
  g <- ggplot(gs_prox) +
    geom_edgespace(color="red")+
    geom_nodespace(color="black",
                   size = .2,pch = 19) +
    scale_colour_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range)+
    theme_gspace_coords(theme = "th3",is_norm = TRUE)+
    theme_minimal()+
    labs(title = paste("Cell proximity, dist=",dist_vec[i]),x=NULL,y=NULL)
  png_files <- c(png_files,g)
  
  edges_by_dist[i,]$edges <-ecount(gs_prox@graph)
  print(paste("Iteration:",i,"Dist = ",dist_vec[i],"OK"))
}
fim <- Sys.time()
tempo <- fim - inicio
tempo

```

## Save animation frames

Save each collected plot to images/frames/; this directory must exist before running this section.

```{r step-07, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
file_paths <- sapply(seq_along(png_files), function(i) {
  file_path <- file.path("images/frames/", sprintf("frame_%03d.png", i))
  
  # ggsave handles saving the ggplot object automatically
  ggsave(
    filename = file_path, 
    plot = png_files[[i]], 
    width = 6,      # Width in inches
    height = 6,     # Height in inches
    dpi = 100       # 6 inches * 100 dpi = 600x600 pixels
  )
  
  return(file_path)
})

```

## Create the animation

Combine the saved frames into a GIF.

```{r step-08, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
gifski(png_files = file_paths[-1],
       gif_file = "images/CellProx_Dist.gif",
       width = 600,
       height = 600,
       delay = 0.2)

```

## Plot edge counts

Plot the number of edges against the distance threshold and save the figure.

```{r step-09, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
g<- ggplot(edges_by_dist,aes(x=dist,y=edges))+
         geom_line()+
         geom_point()+
  labs(y="Number of edges")

ggsave("images/Proximity_Dist_numberEdges.png",g,
       height = 4,width = 7,units = "in",dpi = 120)
######################################################
```

## Calculate mean polygon diameter

Load the diameter helper, calculate each cell diameter, and compute their mean.

```{r step-10, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Calculate the greates distance btween any pair of its vertices
# load function that calculate the maximum distance of a polygon (polygon diameter)
source("R/maxDistPol_func.R")

# Assign maximum distance (polygon diameter)
all_geom <- gs_crop@nodes %>% select(vertex,geometry)

for(i in 1:length(all_geom$geometry)){
  all_geom$maxDist[i] <- maxDistPol(all_geom$geometry[i])
}
gs_vertex_attr(gs_crop, "maxDist") <- all_geom$maxDist
rm(all_geom)

# Store the meanMaxDist between all the cell polygons
meanMaxDist <- mean(gs_vertex_attr(gs_crop, "maxDist"))
######################################################        
```

## Compare the threshold with cell diameter

Express the selected distance threshold as a fraction of the mean polygon diameter.

```{r step-11, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
0.0005/meanMaxDist
```
